scope: A provisional cross-case mechanism for insurgent persistence and counterinsurgency interruption; no efficacy or transfer claim is licensed.
binding_conditions: an initiation, mobilization, or recruitment response

claims.claim: Insurgent persistence may be better represented by viable local reproduction than by national manpower or violence totals alone, conditional on a stable case-specific observation process.
missing: preregistered cross-case holdout comparison against reduced manpower and violence-only competitors
full historical current-core impact assessment for Nepal and Afghanistan beyond initialization
independent measurement validation of local reproduction
stability of local-renewal lift across case-native event strata
case-cross hazard-scale identification without outcome fitting
control and joint-outcome improvement beyond violence-only prediction
claims.falsifier: A simpler model predicts held-out control and joint outcomes at least as well across the preregistered cases, or the local-renewal lift disappears under actor-identity and reporting-persistence alternatives.

claims.claim: Exposure/contact, initiation or recruitment, and local sustainment are conjunctive prerequisites for reproduction.
missing: superseding-certified-core multi-seed challenge replication
case-level activation genealogy with parent attribution
complete assignment and split sensitivity analysis
claims.falsifier: A mechanism can reproduce local episodes reliably when one of the three conditions is deliberately removed.

claims.claim: Geographic adjacency can shape renewal and spatial concentration, but adjacency alone is not evidence of reproduction.
missing: verified actor- or parent-attributed adjacent activation beyond recorded dyad labels
parent-attributed geographic propagation
cross-case holdout comparison with common observation operators
claims.falsifier: Neighbor restriction fails to change adjacent activation or spatial concentration once contact and activation pathways are exercised, or recorded-dyad adjacency does not exceed reverse-time and topology-label nulls.

claims.claim: Persistent presence matters through a memory/control pathway, not as static occupancy alone.
missing: certified-core revalidation of the eight-seed challenge
control and expectation outcomes beyond memory stock
cross-case presence/operator validation
claims.falsifier: Formation-memory treatment changes neither local control nor renewal when contact and focal exposure are held available.

claims.claim: Counterinsurgency succeeds when it interrupts local reproduction with persistent credible security, information, governance, and changed expectations.
missing: preregistered intervention runs
joint control/harm/capacity outcomes
holdout and reduced-model comparisons in at least two cases
claims.falsifier: Interventions that interrupt the proposed cycle do not improve declared control or joint outcomes, or only reduce violence while worsening harm and dependence.

claims.claim: Insurgent movement is plausibly a portfolio of frontier expansion, foothold consolidation, stronghold retention, and uncertainty-driven exploration, constrained by route risk and sanctuary access.
missing: historical movement reconstruction
cross-case holdout comparison against simpler movement models
evidence that the portfolio changes local reproduction rather than only trajectories
claims.falsifier: A simpler movement rule matches held-out spatial concentration and local-control outcomes, or the declared route/sanctuary monotonicities fail in a settled implementation.

promotion_rule: No claim becomes a stable general theory until its missing evidence is satisfied in the case ladder, the simplest competitors are beaten on frozen holdouts, and the active core has a superseding reproducibility certificate.
current_blockers: live core hash continues to change and does not match the active freeze
Nepal and Afghanistan artifacts are bound to earlier source snapshots
current-core Nepal and Afghanistan initialization preflights pass, but no full historical transfer impact has been licensed
adjacent activation and historical parent-attributed reproduction remain unidentified
the four-case violence-only adjacency contrasts show no robust temporal-direction margin
stratum sensitivity is descriptive, while incomplete location assignment and Nepal monthly split mixing remain unresolved
current-core hazard sensitivity is single-case and fixed-seed; it does not identify a transferable hazard scale
interpretation: This matrix is a disciplined candidate-theory ledger. It records what the accumulated evidence constrains without converting synthetic pathway recovery into a general empirical law.
